segments.vv3:1.1: “Pīṭhaṃ te sovaṇṇamayaṃ uḷāraṃ, manojavaṃ gacchati yenakāmaṃ;
segments.vv3:2.1: “Kena tetādiso vaṇṇo, kena te idha mijjhati;
segments.vv3:2.3: Uppajjanti ca te bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.
segments.vv3:3.1: “Pucchāmi taṃ devi mahānubhāve, manussabhūtā kimakāsi puññaṃ;
segments.vv3:3.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv3:4.3: Pañhaṃ puṭṭhā viyākāsi, yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv3:5.1: “Appassa kammassa phalaṃ mamedaṃ [mametaṃ (ka.)], yenamhi [tenamhi (ka.)] evaṃ jalitānubhāvā;
segments.vv3:5.3: Ahaṃ manussesu manussabhūtā, purimāya jātiyā manussaloke.
segments.vv3:6.3: Tassa adāsahaṃ pīṭhaṃ, pasannā sehi pāṇibhi.
segments.vv3:7.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo, tena me idha mijjhati;
segments.vv3:7.3: Uppajjanti ca me bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.
segments.vv3:8.1: “Akkhāmi te bhikkhu mahānubhāva, manussabhūtā yamakāsi puññaṃ;
segments.vv3:8.3: Tenamhi evaṃ jalitānubhāvā, vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
